description.value: Cioffi's Cucina is the scratch-made kitchen arm of Cioffi's Italian Meat Market & Deli, a family-run Burnaby institution operating for over 25 years. Award-winning chef Jason Symington turns out daily hot specials, housemade panini, fresh pasta, and baked goods drawing directly from the adjacent deli and meat counter. A touring cyclist can grab anything from a quick Lavazza espresso to a full cold-pack of lasagna, arancini, or roasted chicken to go.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active Italian cafe and grab-and-go kitchen with confirmed website presence and rich menu content; a practical stop for touring cyclists needing food, coffee, or ready-made meals.
